  • [ - ] Zoltan - member since 15-Feb-20

    4 goals and still a very boring, hard fought encounter: I purposely didn't call it a game, because it lacked playfulness and creativity. The commentators formulated perfectly the reason I hate the Premiership: they said "there was no indication whatsoever that Spurs would come back". Everything is unpredictable in the Premiership: the form of the players (changes from one game to another), the form of the teams (SAME), the goals (they come from out of the blue because there is no FLOW to the the encounters - the encounters are riddled with fights during which the ball might bounce in an unexpected way, so one team, or another FINDS A GOAL). I think this last point is the most important: despite the enormous amount of money spent on outstanding players, in the Premiership the goals are still FOUND, NOT scored, much like in the lowly Belgian top league - another league in which I hate to bet because the outcome of the encounters is totally based on luck.
